summary: Export any view to PDF or Excel and show the impact PIM Manager has, with your company name kept off screen by default.

new.title: Export any table to PDF or Excel
new.text: Use the new Export menu in the header to save any page that shows a table as PDF or Excel. The export shows exactly what the page shows and is audited.

new.title: Impact counters on a new overview
new.text: The new Counters overview shows activations, standing access made eligible, standing-access hours removed, approvals, reviews and more, with how each is counted.

new.title: Company name hidden on screen by default
new.text: The Dashboard and Counters overview hide the company and environment name by default, also in every export, so you can safely show them in a meeting.

new.title: Private link between managing and managed tenants
new.text: A managing / managed tenant pair can now connect over a private path without network peering. Built, not yet proven live; the public, signed path stays the default.

new.title: Hybrid worker improvements
new.text: The hybrid worker now reaches a private-only PIM database, works with domain controllers behind a hub gateway, and can be removed cleanly with one command.
